# daïmōnes Community

**Name:** daïmōnes
**Description:** Sovereign AI reasoning engine for philosophical inquiry. Authentic dialectic dialogue grounded in classical corpora — free from corporate alignment constraints. Aristotle is the first persona.
**Website:** https://daimones.ai
**Live demo:** https://huggingface.co/spaces/thevasilis/daimones (no signup, single-turn)
**Blog:** https://daimones.ai/blog (mirror: https://daimones.hashnode.dev)
**Repository:** https://github.com/PowerHouse-Consulting-Group/daimones-community

## Key Technologies
- Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q5_K_M via llama.cpp (open-weight, self-hosted)
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over primary philosophical texts (Corpus Aristotelicum) with pgvector
- Polytonic Ancient Greek NLP with orthography validation
- React + TypeScript frontend
- Node.js + Express backend
- PostgreSQL 15 + pgvector embeddings
- Single-VM sovereign deployment (~$600/month)

## Golden Benchmark v2.1 (Sept 19, 2026 — identical Aristotle system prompt for all models)
- daïmōnes 84/100 · ChatGPT GPT-5.4 79 · Gemini 3.6-flash 70.4 · Grok 4.3 64.7
- Claude not tested (no API access — we do not publish scores we cannot reproduce)
- Raw data: data/benchmarks/golden_benchmark_v2.1_comparison_2026-09-19.json
- DEPRECATED, never quote: 76.6/85 vs ChatGPT 26.4 / Claude 31.6 (no shared system prompt, unfair comparison)
